title: We’ve designed Muse with deep regard for security and privacy, and we take every single report of a possible security problem extremely seriously. In this case, it is worth walking through the data access controls that govern Muse’s access to user data on Macs. The Messages integration in the Muse Mac App is opt-in. Your Muse can only read Messages content if macOS system-level Full Disk Access is granted and the Messages connector is enabled.
